question: After a partial instruction revision, is explicit predicted constraint-state updating useful beyond full-history recomputation and a limited rule parser, under a common frozen VLA interface?

scope.unit: shared initial scene + common prefix + revision event; semantic outputs cached per dialogue/arm/model seed, not new independent language samples per physical replay
not_claimed: general multi-turn memory from one revision
robot-wide revocation failure from action failure alone

direct_collision.title: Dead Text or Binding Clause? Measuring and Restoring Constraint Influence in Black-Box LLM Dialogues
direct_collision.boundary: Code-artifact evaluation; ledger compilation already prior art. Available paper does not establish our physical violation-time comparison. Runnable author repository not identified; our baseline is not a ReBIND reproduction.

upper_model.role: First bounded language-only reference for H/S, not asserted strongest model; not added to P0
upper_model.mode: non-thinking, text-only explicit objects; no live image, simulator metadata or native feedback
upper_model.decode_provenance: Sampling settings follow official non-thinking guidance; output/input caps are our unvalidated task budget. Count cap/truncation separately; no silent truncation.
upper_model.deployment: Future local Docker only; schedule upper calls before branching, unload before VLA if needed. Weight checksums, package/image resolution and peak memory remain unverified; same checkpoint/decoding for H/S.
upper_model.scope_limit: If a small model alone fails, do not generalize to strongest available systems. A stronger-model followup would be a new bounded comparison after observing need.

arms.input: all user utterances through current event, fixed vocabulary, common schema
arms.instruction: Recompute the currently active goals and constraints from the complete user history.

arms.input: same complete user history and schema plus its OWN previous predicted state
arms.state: never gold; same initial prediction may be cached/shared if inputs/seed exactly match
arms.instruction: Update your previous predicted state using the new utterance; retain unrelated active requirements.

arms.input: raw user strings and a prespecified limited grammar
arms.instruction: No case-id lookup, annotated edit operation or gold state is available.

arms.input: human expected state via the common renderer; not a performance upper bound
new atomic goal without the protected-object constraint; same physical snapshot

common_system_prompt: Return one JSON object and no other text. Use only the supplied object vocabulary. Maintain active_goals and active_constraints. A revision that changes only one goal field leaves other goals and constraints in force. Permission is not an obligation to move. Revocation ends a constraint from that event onward; preserve its earlier interval in retired_constraints. Put cancelled goals in cancelled_goals, not active_goals. Do not infer physical completion from the absence of a goal. Reject ambiguous or unsupported language with status=unsupported. Never use a case identifier or a stored answer.

output_contract.validation: Strict JSON object, no extra prose/duplicate keys or unknown objects. Missing fields or unsupported/conflicting active goal/constraint is an explicit failure; no oracle repair. Goal/constraint sets compare by meaning, order not significant. R6 physical completion must be externally evidenced and is outside first automatic comparison.

rule_grammar.normalization: Case/whitespace/punctuation and a frozen alias lexicon only; preserve negation, only, instead, current/original and temporal markers.
supported_operations: Put X on D -> active on(X,D)
Change only X destination to D -> replace target of X goal; preserve unrelated slots
Replace task with Put X on D -> cancel former task goal, set new goal
Keep X at current position and orientation -> pose constraint referenced to the utterance event
Cancel prohibition on moving X / X may move -> retire that constraint; no new movement goal
rule_grammar.ordering: Process clauses in textual order; explicit cancellation before replacement. Unsupported/ambiguous scope aborts, not best-effort gold correction.
rule_grammar.coverage: Restricted author-written grammar, not natural-language robustness; report unsupported rate and each operator separately

renderer.order: Canonical object order bowl,bottle,cheese; goals then constraints; no model-written commentary.
renderer.pose_t0: Keep the {object_name} at its original position and orientation.
renderer.pose_tau: From now on, keep the {object_name} at its current position and orientation.
renderer.invalid_output: abort the arm and record semantic failure, never supply gold fallback

observer_spec.units: positions in metres; unit quaternions; rotation in radians
observer_spec.pose_violation: any pre/post state of an action owned by the interval exceeds frozen translation OR rotation tolerance
observer_spec.event_boundary: Score the last pre-revision action and its post-state before applying revocation/addition; new reference at s_tau
observer_spec.unknown: missing/nonfinite pose, zero-norm quaternion, missing tick or unvalidated coordinate frame yields unknown, not no-violation
observer_spec.goal: Original On predicate at common endpoint; label this native predicate, not proven stable human placement
observer_spec.temporal_scope: sampled control-action boundaries only, not continuous-time collision safety
observer_spec.post_goal_policy: same H after tau; first-hit retained only as secondary; do not add oracle early stop

before_effect_comparison: Validate pose frame/unit and quaternion order from actual model
Use no-command drift and a known nonzero dev displacement to choose tolerances that distinguish them; if no separating interval, observer unqualified
Choose common H using atomic/oracle competence on separate dev only; freeze before H/S/R outcomes
Verify tokenizer no-truncation for all renderer outputs
Serialize physics/controller/grasp/RNG/queue and verify same initial observations
calibration.retry_policy: No automatic new rollout; P0 budget stays unchanged

analysis.primary: paired difference in post-revision goal AND active-interval compliance: S minus H, on pre-revision-eligible shared prefixes
context_metrics: all planned attempts incl semantic failure
analysis.missing: Technical missingness remains unknown for scientific success, no verified success operationally. Show complete-case separately and pairwise lower/upper bounds.
analysis.no_mechanism_overclaim: S-H changes explicit predicted-state input and computation; both see full history, so not pure memory capacity or token compression.
analysis.clustering: ancestor scene/prefix; repeated prompts/seeds are not independent scenes

counterexamples_reviewed: R5 permission does not force movement
R1 compliance can occur with no constraint use
R4 failure despite correct semantic state need not be residual prohibition
q and -q are the same orientation
goal first-hit followed by later active constraint violation is not joint success
an invalid previous state cannot be silently replaced by gold for S
